title: JointShocks
description: An R package for joint and generalized spillover analysis using vector autoregressions.

title: U.S. Labor Market Tightness Dashboard
description: Measures U.S. labor market tightness using the unemployment gap (u − u*). It presents three views: a 68% credible-set view, a gap standardized by its sample standard deviation, and a gap scaled by an approximate standard error of the Kansas City Fed u* estimate.

title: U.S. Employment Dynamics Dashboard
description: Tracks payroll employment across major U.S. industries and states using BLS Current Employment Statistics data. The industry view shows employment changes, sector contributions, and shares of total payroll employment; the state map compares month-over-month growth, year-over-year growth, and states’ shares of U.S. employment.

title: Monetary Policy Gap Tracker
description: Compares the real policy rate with alternative estimates of r* to assess whether U.S. monetary policy appears restrictive, neutral, or accommodative. Users can select the policy rate, inflation-expectations measure, natural-rate estimates, and date range, and compare current readings with historical policy gaps.
